_comment: Decision-rule constants for PN1 (pre-registered; owner decisions D1-D4 of 2026-11-10). Data, not code. D1: the three zones and thresholds are unchanged. D2: token rules apply to LOOP-ONLY output tokens (R_LOOP); the numeric limits are the plan's, now applied to R_LOOP.

cost_limits_d6._comment: D6: a limit L stated on R_B (loop+audit) becomes R_LOOP_limit = round((L*169468 - 69044)/100424, 2). The original L no longer applies to R_LOOP. Cost never stops a run (D6.2): these limits enter only the final, post-hoc verdict.

drop2_r_loop.note: DROP-2: plan limit R_TOK > 3.3 (arm-1 cost level) -> R_LOOP > 4.88

cost_limits_d6.mid_run_cost_checks: none exist; no harness step reads running tokens to stop, abort, truncate or skip a run (D6.2). Token counts are read only after a step has finished.
